1000126.etyen:
Internationalism, ultimately based on Somali Soomaali (“Somali”), the ethnonym of the Somali people, with the international geographical ending -ia. The corresponding Somali country name is Soomaaliya (“Somalia”).
The deeper origin of Soomaali is uncertain. A traditional explanation connects the ethnonym with Samaale, an ancestral figure in Somali genealogical tradition, but this is not securely established as its historical etymology.
The geographical ending -ia ultimately continues Latin -ia, alongside Ancient Greek -ία (-ía) and -εια (-eia).
Parallel international forms include Norwegian Ny

Last part nes (“headland”), from Old Norse nes (“headland”), from Proto-Germanic *nasją (“headland”), from Proto-Indo-European *néh₂s (“nostril; nose”).
